format_owner: Developer-maintained PHP implementations selected by TagFormatFactory (fd18-v1, native-v1)
metadata_owner: gov-store/metadata MetadataValueStore; company code lists, office selections, office enablement and product-type Finance defaults; no native model property

classification.unspsc_link: gov_finance_items.unspsc_code is a soft link to gov_catalog_nodes.code; nullable; several Finance items may share it
classification.product_default: Optional; one row per product type in gov_metadata_values (subject category); owner = national for global types, company for company types

tag_kinds.fd18-v1: Govt. Tag (UI label); requires active Finance Code, acquisition date from Supplier Challan/PO date and a Purchase receipt
tag_kinds.native-v1: Standard tag from the native prefix/sequence
tag_kinds.entered-v1: Tag typed in an office that is not enabled (legacy behaviour, guarded)

physical_tag: Existing assets.asset_tag; gov_asset_registrations.asset_tag retains the permanent reservation

integration.issuer_contract: store-operations Contracts/AssetTagIssuer; NullAssetTagIssuer default; AssetTagIssuerAdapter bound when asset-tagging is installed
